data: Bundled demo portfolio only. Cleared only the synthetic QA project-draft key; portfolio data and saved view were preserved.

observations.earlierObservationCorrection: A previous QA draft contained whitespace-only title and description, so required attributes treated those fields as non-empty and focus progressed. That run was not a clean empty-form test and is superseded by this protocol.
observations.crossCheck: Direct Android WebView DOM check confirmed empty title/description, invalid controls title then description, and focus on title after submitting. Isolated mobile Chromium likewise retained focus on title.
